subject: QBR compact: account lanes, forecast stitch, and pre-read asks
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:09:00 -0700
Subject: QBR compact: account lanes, forecast stitch, and pre-read asks

Team —

As we lock the QBR packet for Helix (executive readout next Wed 8/25), I want a compact, account-level lanes view we can hand the execs and the AEs. Goal: one page per account with 3 bullets (current ask, forecast delta from last QBR, risk & mitigation). I attached a starter PDF and the stitch CSV that feeds the slide pack.

High level:
- Total ACV we show: $1.8M (current) — need confirmation by EOD Friday.
- Core ask from Helix: finalize pricing for Dedicated capacity + 6-mo pilot for sensitive workloads.
- Roadblock: procurement requested SOC2 evidence + a short runbook for private deployment timeline.

Per-account asks (populate the CSV column named "compact_notes"):
- Helix-Platform (account lead: Emma): confirm close probability and next milestone (demo date / PO).
- Helix-RetirementOps (account lead: Rajiv): update expected procurement ETA and legal redlines.
- Helix-Data (internal top-opportunity): confirm quantization/latency SLO decisions (we recommended q4_8 profile).

Please update helix_forecast_stitch_v3.csv with numbers + a one-line exec summary for each account by Friday 08/20 5pm PT. Mina — can you draft the SOC2 evidence list and a one-page private-deploy runbook we can send to Procurement? Ben — coordinate with Solutions on latency SLO wording.

Attachments: Helix_QBR_account_cards.pdf (starter one-pagers), helix_forecast_stitch_v3.csv (single-row-per-account forecast).

Thanks — keep this compact. We want to avoid a 12-slide deep-dive in the exec packet.

Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR compact: account lanes, forecast stitch, and pre-read asks

Dylan —

I've updated helix_forecast_stitch_v3.csv with the latest ACV splits and short summaries in the compact_notes column. Quick notes per account (pulled into the PDF as well):

1) Helix-Platform — ACV $820k, probability 60% -> Notes: Emma requested a final dedicated pricing worksheet after the demo (scheduled 8/24 2pm PT). Procurement asked for KBA on data residency. Action: I set a follow-up with Emma and Procurement for 8/24 4pm to confirm PO cadence.

2) Helix-RetirementOps — ACV $430k, probability 35% -> Notes: Rajiv flagged two legal clauses (liability cap; indemnity carve-out). Legal is reviewing; expect answers by 8/23 COB. Procurement ETA tentative 9/3.

3) Helix-Data — ACV $550k, probability 75% -> Notes: internal green on model perf; Mina and Solutions validated q4_8 quant profile. Ask: confirm go/no-go on private deployment during pilot (affects billing ramp).

I attached a short annotated version of the account cards where I pulled the executive bullets. I left longer technical detail out of the executive pre-read — saved to the Drive link.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Helix_QBR_account_cards_annotated.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR compact: account lanes, forecast stitch, and pre-read asks

Quick confirmation:
- Solutions validated latency targets for Helix-Data under q4_8 quantization; we recommend the "fast-start" runtime profile for demo to show tail latency improvements. Mina has the perf logs.
- I'll draft the SOW clause clarifying rollout phases (pilot -> dedicated -> private) and share redline suggestions by EOD.

Mina — can you assemble the SOC2 evidence checklist plus a short private-deploy timeline (two-slide PDF) so Procurement has what they need to evaluate? I'll include both in the packet I prep for legal.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR compact: account lanes, forecast stitch, and pre-read asks

Thanks — clear progress. Final items before I sign off the executive packet tomorrow morning:

1) Marissa: tighten the Helix-Platform one-liner to include the demo objective ("validate private workload latency and procurement readiness") and remove product-level features.
2) Ben: share the SOW redline as a single patch file (legal prefers one artifact).
3) Mina: SOC2 evidence checklist + 2-slide private-deploy timeline by EOD today; include expected owner for each artifact.
4) Dylan: confirm total ACV to show in slide header (Marissa's spreadsheet currently sums to $1.8M — confirm if we should round to $1.75M for conservative exec view).

I'll assemble the packet once these 4 are in Drive. We're targeting a 6-slide exec pre-read + 1 appendix with the compact account cards.

Laura Bennett
VP, Head of GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
